lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected acute food insecurity classification data on a regular monthly schedule in 2011, assigning IPC (Integrated Food Security Phase Classification) scale values to geographic areas under different scenarios. The data represents post-assessment impact classifications of food insecurity conditions across Somalia.
